subject: Dedicated capacity demo: throughput & calendar coordination
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@quantify.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (self signup)

Hi Lukas,

We just completed a self-signup on Redwood and ran some quick tests against the hosted API. Our app (QuantifyAI) is moving to a production path and we want to evaluate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput.

High-level requirements:
- Sustained ~80 QPS (spiky to 120 QPS)
- Typical request: 600 tokens (prompt + response), avg sequence length ~600
- Target latency: 95th <= 250ms for short-response flows, tail can be higher for longer generations
- Region: us-west preferred

Can we schedule a 30–45m technical walkthrough focused on capacity sizing, latency expectations, and what to expect from a Dedicated reservation? I attached our QPS/traffic sketch (quantify_qps_requirements.pdf).

Suggested windows (PDT): Tue 5/7 11:00–12:00, Wed 5/8 09:00–10:00, Fri 5/10 13:00–14:00. We can be flexible.

Thanks — happy to share sample prompts if helpful.

Best,
Anjali Rao
Co-founder, QuantifyAI
anjali@quantify.ai

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@quantify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (self signup)

Anjali — thanks for the note and the attachment, really helpful. I’m Lukas on the Solutions team; looping in Ben (SDR/AE) and Marissa (Capacity specialist) to make sure we cover sizing and the Dedicated demo runbook.

Quick read: the traffic sketch looks sensible. Before the walkthrough it’d help if you can confirm two quick items so we tailor the demo:
- Real-world avg tokens per request (you noted ~600 — is that steady across calls or are you mixing short/long flows?)
- Expected concurrent sessions (how many independent concurrent users/streams map to that 80 QPS?)

Proposed plan for the call: 15 min discovery + 20–25 min walk through Dedicated pool sizing, autoscale/burst options, and a short Q/A. If that works, which of these two times is best for you (PDT):
- Tue 5/7 11:30–12:00 (we can compress to 30m)
- Wed 5/8 09:00–09:45 (45m slot)

I’m attaching a provisional calendar (.ics) for Tue 5/7 11:30; if you accept I’ll confirm and Marissa will prepare a quick throughput checklist and sample run to validate the QPS profile. Also, if you can upload 5–10 representative prompts to the Drive folder in the related_links above, we’ll run them in a short smoke test during the call.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Lukas Meyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: quantify_proposed_meeting.ics

From: Anjali Rao <anjali@quantify.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Carter <sam.carter@quantify.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (self signup)

Thanks Lukas — Tue 11:30 works for us, but Sam (ops lead) asked if we can move it 30m earlier to 11:00 PDT because we have an internal sync right after.

Answers to your questions:
- The 600 tokens is an average; about 70% of calls are 300–700 tokens, 30% are long-form ~1200 tokens.
- Concurrent sessions estimate: 40–60 concurrent streams during peak (the 80 QPS assumes batching and short-polling semantics).

We uploaded 6 sample prompts to the Drive folder and included a CSV with per-flow token counts.

If 11:00–11:45 Tue works, we’ll accept the invite. Also please send dial-in details.

Best,
Anjali

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@quantify.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo (self signup)

Perfect — 11:00–11:45 PDT on Tue 5/7 it is. I updated the calendar invite (attached) to 45m and included a short agenda and a Meet link.

Agenda (brief):
1) 10–15m discovery — production traffic, regions, security controls (KMS, VPC if relevant)
2) 15m sizing & Dedicated pool options — sustained QPS, burst, autoscale policy tradeoffs
3) 10m smoke test plan and next steps (sample prompts + follow-up capacity validation run)

Marissa — can your team prepare a short runbook to validate QuantifyAI’s mixed traffic (70% short/30% long) so we can show expected 95th-percentile latency and token-cost projection during the call? If we need a quick pre-demo run we can do it in the 30–45 minute slot but if not we’ll schedule a dedicated load test next week.

Anjali/Sam — dial-in: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/quantify-5-7 (passcode: QNT2029). Please accept the updated invite (quantify_proposed_meeting.ics). I’ve also copied Markus, our sales manager, in case the conversation moves to reserved capacity commitments and pricing.

See you Tuesday — I’ll bring the runbook and one of our capacity engineers will join if the smoke test is needed.

—
Lukas
